# Local graph rendering assets

`vis-network.min.js` and `vis-network.css` are the unmodified vis-network 9.1.2 assets distributed with the PyVis 0.3.2 wheel from PyPI. This package was downloaded for the browser assets only; it is not installed or required at runtime. Streamlit serves these files locally. No CDN or external font is used.

Origin: https://pypi.org/project/pyvis/0.3.2/
Upstream: https://visjs.github.io/vis-network/

SHA-256:

- pyvis-0.3.2-py3-none-any.whl: `5720c4ca8161dc5d9ab352015723abb7a8bb8fb443edeb07f7a322db34a97555`
- vis-network.min.js: `1f20f0736f32cb9bedf8f6383b25cfea2f839e1abe80d6e8040b4d5bea378c69`
- vis-network.css: `2e82d445ad5878ea881652470ce632601f8f55f1b99e6ebecdff8614600e6d0e`

The original vis-network header provides the copyright notices and the choice of Apache-2.0 or MIT licensing. These assets are redistributed under MIT; its terms are in `VIS-LICENSE.txt`. PyVis distribution notices are retained in `PYVIS-LICENSE.txt`.
